messages:
Maya: quick sync — customer RainShadow flagged a compliance gap: they require 13 months of immutable audit logs for KMS and S3 object access. worried this could surface in renewal review.
Jordan: on it. our standard private/VPC guidance recommends customer-managed CMK + CloudTrail -> their S3. docs currently say 12 months in one spot and 'archive policy' elsewhere. need to reconcile.
Tess: they explicitly put 13 months in their compliance checklist. can we match that without special add-on?
Arjun: technically yes — we forward CloudTrail (management + data events) and KMS events to the customer's bucket. retention is controlled by their S3 lifecycle. sample lifecycle to preserve ~13 months: ```aws s3api put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --bucket rainshadow-logs --lifecycle-configuration '{\"Rules\":[{\"ID\":\"keep-13-months\",\"Status\":\"Enabled\",\"Expiration\":{\"Days\":395}}]}'```
Jordan: also ensure CloudTrail is logging KMS events like CreateKey, RotateKey, ReEncrypt, ScheduleKeyDeletion so key ops are captured. retention = bucket lifecycle.
Maya: customer expects us to 'guarantee' 13mo immutable logs. we don't host their logs by default. if they want us to host/retention-lock, that's an add-on and legal review. Tess, please mark this as a renewal risk until we confirm.
Tess: noted. putting a renewal-risk flag on their account (monitoring). I'll add pricing delta for hosted-retention option and attach to renewal playbook. ticket created: CS-2025-4891.
Jordan: infra check: forwarder sample_rate=1.0 for RainShadow, last 30d delivery: 0 drops. audit-exporter-bot: Delivery OK — last run 2025-11-03T14:22Z (sha: a1b2c3).
audit-exporter-bot: Delivery OK — 0 failed uploads in last 30d.
Arjun: will prepare a CloudTrail filter example and a KMS management-events snippet to put in the onboarding runbook. also include a note about using S3 Object Lock/legal hold if they require immutability beyond lifecycle.
Maya: action items:
- Jordan: update onboarding docs to explicitly state \"customer-managed CMK\" and include the lifecycle snippet above. confirm wording.
- Arjun: add CloudTrail policy/sample filter for KMS events and example commands for lifecycle + object-lock guidance.
- Tess: track renewal risk, add pricing for hosting/retention add-on, attach ticket CS-2025-4891 to renewal workbook.
- Maya: draft reply to RainShadow with steps, ETA, and options (self-managed retention vs Redwood-hosted retention).
Jordan: ack — will push doc edits today.
Arjun: ack — PR for examples incoming.
Tess: ack — ticket linked to renewal sheet.
Maya: replied to customer with steps + ETA; left renewal status as \"monitoring\" until we hear back on chosen path. moving follow-ups into CS-2025-4891. :white_check_mark:
thread_summary: Onboarding sync about RainShadow's request for 13 months of KMS + S3 audit retention. Clarified we forward logs to customer-managed bucket and retention is controlled via S3 lifecycle; hosting/immutable retention is an add-on and flagged as a renewal risk. Action items assigned and ticket CS-2025-4891 opened.
